update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.33 - Generation farm replaces cold start
Changes --- - Removed cold start (team-home navigation) entirely - New generation farm flow: start on career selection; breeding plan drives multi-run goal queue - Bot start auto-enables multi-run and resolves per-generation patches (trainee, scenario, factors, legacy parent) - Goal queue patches advance settings between careers without home navigation - Legacy parent and harvest OCR read active generation patch at runtime
Includes v5.9.32 reliability fixes and v5.9.31 support card optimizations.
